output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set by initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals), where initialSupply is provided by the owner and can be set to a very high value, causing totalSupply to overflow and become very small in value, devaluing the token.
The transfer function appears to be correct. No vulnerabilities have been identified.
